verdict.rationale: The docs say you can "create your first agent with a single command", which implies an official scaffolding CLI. Studio running at localhost:4111 hints at a local dev command, but the pack never names a CLI or documents its commands. missing for 10: an explicitly named official CLI with documented commands (create/dev/build/deploy), AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI usage.
